passages.title: A note to a neighbour about noise
sentences: Hello neighbour, I live in the flat directly below yours.
I usually wake up at five thirty for my morning shift.
These days, loud music is playing late at night from upstairs.
My young daughter needs quiet sleep before her school bus arrives.
Please turn the volume down after nine in the evening.

passages.title: Booking a clinic visit
sentences: Good morning, I am calling to book an appointment this week.
I have a sore throat and a mild cough right now.
The doctor usually sees morning patients between eight and eleven o'clock.
I work in town, so an early slot suits me best.
I am bringing my clinic card and national ID with me.

passages.title: Morning check-in at the office
sentences: Our small team meets every Monday morning before the office opens.
Today I am checking the stock list for our Westlands shop.
My colleague answers customer calls while I update the delivery sheet.
The courier normally arrives at ten o'clock with the fresh boxes.
We keep every signed receipt inside the blue folder by the door.

passages.title: Afternoon shop handover
sentences: I finish my morning shift at two o'clock every weekday.
Right now, two customers are waiting near the front counter.
The printer is working slowly today, so please check each page.
Our supplier sends new invoices to the shop email each Friday.
Please lock the side gate before you leave in the evening.

passages.title: Describing last weekend
sentences: Last Saturday, I woke up early and cleaned the whole house.
After lunch, we took a matatu to visit my aunt in Rongai.
We sat outside in the shade and drank hot spiced tea.
On Sunday afternoon, I bought fresh vegetables from the open market.
Next weekend, we are going to stay home and rest.

passages.title: A message to a child's school
sentences: Good morning teacher, my son missed class yesterday because of rain.
The main road flooded near our estate, and no buses passed.
We checked the timetable together last night and finished his homework.
Today I am going to walk him to the school gate.
I will send a signed note in his bag this afternoon.

passages.title: Explaining a delivery delay
sentences: Good afternoon, I am writing about your order for thirty boxes.
Our van left the warehouse at seven, as we planned yesterday.
Heavy traffic stopped all vehicles along Mombasa Road for two hours.
The driver took an alternative route and reached town ten minutes ago.
He will arrive at your reception desk before half past three.

passages.title: Confirming a client site visit
sentences: Thank you for sending the floor plan to our office yesterday.
Our engineer reviewed the measurements and prepared the final quote.
Tomorrow morning, we are going to visit your Kilimani office at nine.
We will test the internet sockets and check the meeting room.
After the visit, I will email a clear schedule before five.

passages.title: A short work update
sentences: We have completed the first stage of the Kilimani clinic renovation.
The electrician has tested all the lights in the waiting room.
However, the paint supplier has delayed our final order until Thursday.
We moved the reception desks yesterday so the floor stays clean.
I will send updated photos once the painter finishes this Friday.

passages.title: Follow-up with the landlord
sentences: Good morning, the kitchen tap has leaked for three days now.
I have placed a bucket underneath to protect the wooden cupboard.
We also noticed a loose lock on the main balcony door.
Two neighbours have already reported similar plumbing issues on this floor.
Please let me know when the plumber will visit our flat.

passages.title: Returning from leave
sentences: I have just returned from five days of annual leave upcountry.
While I was away, my teammate handled all the urgent client requests.
I have already read through this week's emails and project notes.
Two invoices have arrived since Monday, and both look completely accurate.
I will join the afternoon planning call to confirm next week's targets.

passages.title: Planning a community clean-up
sentences: Our estate committee has organised a neighbourhood clean-up for Saturday morning.
Several residents have offered wheelbarrows, heavy gloves, and large refuse bags.
Last month, blocked drains caused standing water near the primary school.
We have asked the county office to collect the full bags.
My family is going to bring cold water for the volunteers.
